A1.justification: Both PDFs describe BEWO-1M and SpatialSonic. Their complete main texts, references, equations, tables, figures and appendices are readable and support comparison across renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original generation benchmarks, component ablations, dataset analyses and human evaluations in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains original experimental results and adds Clotho generation, retrieval, audio captioning and supplementary diagnostic experiments.

M1.justification: The core architecture, objectives and Appendix E remain unchanged. However, v2 Figure 4 reverses the AFM query/key-value assignments while Equation 4 remains unchanged, and simulation Equation 14 drops the motion-start offset. The PDFs do not resolve whether these reflect procedural changes or documentation errors.

E1.justification: v2 adds actual Clotho generation evaluation and substantially extends coverage to bidirectional audio-text retrieval and audio captioning on AudioCaps, Clotho and BEWO-1M (Appendices G.1, G.5 and G.6). These downstream tasks were only potential applications in v1. The original generation datasets and spatial subsets remain.

E2.justification: New downstream comparisons introduce HTSAT-BERT retrieval baselines trained on AudioCaps/Clotho or pretrained on WavCaps, and CNN14-BART captioning comparisons between WavCaps and BEWO-1M pretraining (Tables G22–G25). The existing generation comparator sets are retained; their reuse on Clotho alone is not a baseline addition.

E3.justification: The downstream experiments introduce zero-shot and fine-tuning protocols, 30% BEWO-1M training subsets, mono/stereo controls, validation-based checkpoint selection, retrieval recall and captioning metrics. New diagnostics sweep CFG scales 4–10 and test class-specific controls. MAE-to-MSE is explicitly a naming correction, not evidence of rerunning experiments. The interactive-clarity description also changes from TDOA to ILD without explaining a calculation change.

E4.justification: v2 adds FSAD directional-mismatch cases (F.3), CFG sensitivity analysis (G.7) and a five-class bias/control study (G.11). Conversely, v1 Table 8's direct regional-perception ablation for audio generation is removed. The retained image-captioning ablation, renumbered from G21 to G27, measures a different outcome and does not replace that evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the 15-participant MOS procedure and approximately 120-evaluator preference study with the same chi-square testing and p-values. Neither adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or uncertainty estimates for model comparisons.

E6.justification: The retained main benchmark tables preserve their numerical results, but v2 adds substantial new outcomes. Examples include Clotho generation FD 18.81 and FAD 3.37 (G17), and BEWO-1M captioning SPIDEr 33.8 versus 10.3 for the WavCaps-trained comparator (G25). New diagnostic results are added, while v1 Table 8's ablation results disappear. These are added or removed findings, not demonstrated version-to-version performance gains.

T1.justification: Appendix B.4 Equation 14 changes the moving trajectory from mu_begin + (t - T_begin)V to mu_begin + tV while retaining the same time interval. This is mathematically non-equivalent and introduces a discontinuity at a nonzero motion-start time. The principal model equations remain unchanged, and no new theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the principal contributions: BEWO-1M, controllable multimodal SpatialSonic and spatial evaluation metrics, including the same claimed 70% ITD-error reduction. The abstract emphasizes text and extensions to other modalities differently, but image and interactive generation remain explicitly claimed in the introduction.

C2.justification: v2 adds explanations of temporal cancellation in mean ITD, CFG tradeoffs and LLM-induced class/scene bias, including failed airplane reverberation control. It also interprets downstream tests as evidence of pretraining utility. The description of captioning differences as marginal overstates Table G24: fine-tuned AudioCaps CIDEr is 57.2 with BEWO-1M pretraining versus 75.6 with WavCaps. Existing major limitations remain.

D1.justification: v2 documents the downstream architectures, adapters, optimizers, learning rates, training durations and checkpoint selection. Appendix J.2 adds contact-on-request plans for 44.1 kHz and 5.1-channel dataset variants, without establishing their release or experimental use. The original SpatialSonic implementation details, hardware and construction prompts are largely retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds references for HTS-AT, BERT, PANNs, BART and captioning metrics, and explicitly follows WavCaps for downstream comparisons. These extend the supporting literature and dataset positioning, while the main related-work discussion and novelty claims remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: The dataset summary, method overview and image-related explanations receive localized rewrites. v2 adds appendix subsections and a revision log, changes a related-work heading, and updates author/conference text. Most existing prose and the main narrative order remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 substantially reformats the document with conference headers, changed typography, text wrapping around Table 1 and Figure 3, and side-by-side main tables. Figure 4 is redrawn with changed attention labels. Eight experimental tables and a CFG plot are added, v1 Table 8 is removed, and retained appendix displays are relocated and renumbered.

improvement.justification: The new Clotho and downstream evaluations provide inspectable evidence for generalization and dataset utility, while FSAD, CFG and bias analyses clarify evaluation behavior and failure conditions. The gain is limited by removal of the direct regional-perception generation ablation, understated captioning gaps in Table G24, and new inconsistencies in Figure 4 and Equation 14. Overall, the additional empirical support modestly improves the paper, with meaningful tradeoffs.
